pier_lines_note: ADR 0198. Authored pier rows per deck (key = OSM way of the deck chain; value = a point of each row on the axis of that deck, local E, N). Read by streetscape.hero_bridge.underdeck_rows; a row stands where it is written, no keep-out search (ADR 0123), a column on the ground footprint is reported in streetscape_qa.json hero_bridges.pier_cols_on_carriageway (must stay empty).

ALL STATIONS ARE WORKING_VALUE, not a survey: no drawings of the object are public (research/mistral/p13-andersa-viaducts P13-032/033 UNVERIFIED) and the piers are hidden by the decks on the orthophoto. Sources of the layout: (1) photos - 7-9 rows per deck in a regular rhythm, no long span (P13-030 / P13-031, ESTIMATED); Panoramax 35224dcb (P13-022, reference only): a pier beside the camera at about 92 m, then 4 rows to the south-east abutment; Panoramax 844e35c7 (P13-027, reference only): 5-6 rows ahead of the camera at about 46 m; Panoramax 3717771d (P13-023): one wider gap on the north-east deck. (2) the generated ground roads: tools/worldgen/qa/check_piers_vs_roads.py - every column of the active rows stands outside the generator keep-out (rasterised ground footprint, about 2.5 m) with at least 1 m of station to spare, and at least 2.5 m from the driven surface. (3) GUGiK orthophoto WMS HighResolution (viewed 2026-11-15, not stored): where the ring carriageways pass under the decks.

Stations in metres from the north-west end of the open range (s_open[0]; 246.34 m on the NE chain, 246.05 m on the SW chain). NE deck 1101181473 (traffic to NW), 8 rows: 24.39, 48.78 (kept from the span rule), 82.5 and 106.0 (the two edges of the centre island, the pattern measured on the sister viaduct in ADR 0123), 133.5 (behind the east ring carriageway), 155.0, 176.5, 198.0 (even spacing to the abutment). Spans 24.4 / 24.4 / 33.7 / 23.5 / 27.5 / 21.5 / 21.5 / 21.5 / 21.5 m (was 16.4 and 48.8 m).

SW deck 173956078 (traffic to SE), 6 active rows: 19.5, 40.0, 56.5 (up to the west ring carriageway; the keep-out of the ground carriageway that runs 2.6-3.4 m south of the columns leaves only short free windows there), 135.5 (behind the east ring carriageway), 161.5, 187.5. Spans 19.5 / 20.5 / 16.5 / 79.0 / 26.0 / 26.0 / 25.8 m (was 94.8 m) - the 79 m span is the open conflict below, not a property of the object.

CONFLICT, SW deck (pier_lines_en_held, never read by the generator): the rows at 86.0 and 111.0 m belong on the centre island (photos: regular rhythm; orthophoto: the island reaches about 1.5-2.5 m beyond the south edge of the SW deck between about 88 and 108 m, WORKING_VALUE by eye), but in the generated world the south-west edge of the island lies under the axis of the SW deck: between 62 and 133 m one column of every possible row stands on the ring asphalt or on the truck apron. The road is not moved here (ADR 0198); once the ring / island geometry is corrected, move the two rows to pier_lines_en - the check script prints 'FREE NOW' for them.
